title: Implement draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-05 (EmailPushConfig, EmailPush)
description: crate-jmap has no EmailPush implementation (no emailPush symbols; an emailPush member in PushSubscription/set lands in the generic extra catch-all, crate-jmap-types push.rs:160-186; JMAP-t8ej.5 notes 'emailpush-04 N/A (no crate)'). Note: Mark's jmapio/jmap EmailPush issues #473-#481 said 'found implementing -04 in crate-jmap', but no such code exists on any branch. Target the editor's -05 (jmapio/jmap f8f44fd, 2026-11-04) so the Nov changes are built in. Optional work: do only if EmailPush support is wanted. Crates: crate-jmap-types, crate-jmap-server, crate-jmap-mail-server, crate-jmap-web-push.
notes:
Decision Mark 2026-11-12: crate-jmap aims to be THE complete reference implementation covering the JMAP specs, so this is required work, not optional. Split rule: the crates own wire types, validation, method semantics and error mapping; storage-, transport- or media-specific work is pushed to the calling crate through backend trait hooks (see the spec-method-defaults memory: no no-op default when that would put wrong data on the wire). This replaces 'Optional work' in the description. Here: EmailPushConfig/EmailPush types, PushSubscription/set validation, filter matching, property selection and push splitting live in the crates; the actual push delivery stays with the caller (crate-jmap-web-push or a caller backend).
2026-11-13: design doc docs/design/emailpush.md; decisions docs/design/DECISIONS.md. Children in dependency order (note key, id, size, title):
